# laravelforge_site_healthcheck (Resource)

Manages the healthcheck endpoint configuration for a Laravel Forge site (singleton).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose healthcheck endpoint is managed.

### Optional

- `healthcheck_endpoint` (String) The endpoint / URL used to perform healthchecks (e.g. `https://my-app.com/up`).
